articles.title: Wife Assaults Teacher Husband in Sitapur Over Alleged Affair; Both File Police Complaints
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A public altercation between a husband and wife in Sitapur’s Tambaur area created a scene on Tuesday evening after the wife allegedly assaulted her husband over suspicions of an illicit relationship with a female colleague.

body.html:
A public altercation between a husband and wife in Sitapur’s Tambaur area created a scene on Tuesday evening after the wife allegedly assaulted her husband over suspicions of an illicit relationship with a female colleague.

The incident occurred under the jurisdiction of Tambaur Police Station. A video of the scuffle has surfaced, showing the wife slapping and dragging her husband by the collar in the middle of the road as a crowd gathered.

Allegations of Affair

According to Meenu Nagar, she married Ajay Nagar in 2014 and the couple has a nine-year-old daughter. Ajay Nagar is a government teacher posted at a primary school in Behta. Meenu alleged that her husband has been involved in an illicit relationship with a female teacher at the same school and has not been fulfilling his family responsibilities for the past four years.

On Tuesday, Meenu, wearing a burqa, along with her mother and daughter, went near the school. She claimed she saw her husband leaving with the female teacher and stopped them at an intersection. An argument followed, which escalated into a physical altercation.

In the viral video, Meenu is heard accusing her husband of ruining her life and allegedly planning a court marriage on the 29th. She also claimed he intended to take the other woman to Nainital.

Counter Allegations

Ajay Nagar has termed the allegations baseless and filed a complaint at the police station. He alleged that his wife, mother-in-law and daughter assaulted him publicly, damaging his reputation.

Inspector-in-charge Brajesh Rai said complaints have been received from both sides and the viral video is being examined. Further legal action will be taken based on statements and available evidence.

Police said the matter is under investigation.

#Sitapur #UttarPradesh #Tambaur #PublicAltercation #TeacherCase #PoliceInvestigation #ViralVideo #BreakingNews

articles.title: Two Youths Booked for Filming Instagram Video in Burqa at Telangana Bus Station
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Two youths were booked on Sunday, February 15, after one of them allegedly posed as a woman by wearing a burqa and scarf at the Korutla bus station in Jagtial district, Telangana.

body.html:
Two youths were booked on Sunday, February 15, after one of them allegedly posed as a woman by wearing a burqa and scarf at the Korutla bus station in Jagtial district, Telangana.

Confirming the incident, Korutla Sub-Inspector Chiranjeevi said the act was carried out to create videos for Instagram.

“The incident took place at the Korutla bus station on Sunday afternoon. The youth wearing a burqa was Mohammed Numan. He had come along with his friend Mohammed Akeel to make Instagram videos,” the officer said.

Numan, 21, reportedly sat in the women’s section of the bus station, which raised suspicion among commuters. An RTC constable noticed that he was a man and immediately informed the police.

Police said Numan had previously made four to five similar videos with Akeel for social media. Numan’s father runs a hotel in Paidimadugu village in Korutla mandal.

Both youths have been booked for a non-cognizable and bailable offence under Section 292 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita and Section 290 of the Indian Penal Code, both relating to public nuisance and punishable with a fine.

Further action will be taken as per law.

#Telangana #Jagtial #Korutla #InstagramReels #PublicNuisance #PoliceAction #BreakingNews

articles.title: Terror of ‘Galghontu’ Gang: Man Choked, Robbed in North East Delhi; CCTV Goes Viral
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A young man was strangled and robbed while walking alone in the Jafrabad area of Delhi, with CCTV footage of the incident now circulating widely on social media. The video shows the victim carrying a bag when two men approach him and start a conversation.

body.html:
A young man was strangled and robbed while walking alone in the Jafrabad area of Delhi, with CCTV footage of the incident now circulating widely on social media.

The video shows the victim carrying a bag when two men approach him and start a conversation. Within seconds, a third accused comes from behind, grabs him by the throat and puts him in a chokehold.

As the victim struggles, the other two men search his pockets. The trio then flee the spot with his cash and bag.

The incident has been linked to the notorious “Galghontu” (choking) gang, known for using similar tactics to overpower victims before robbing them.

Police are examining the CCTV footage and conducting further investigation into the case.

articles.title: Drunk Man Blocks BMTC Bus, Abuses Driver in Bengaluru’s Indiranagar
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A drunk man allegedly created a major disturbance in Indiranagar, Bengaluru, on February 17, 2026, by standing in front of a Bengaluru Metropolitan Transport Corporation (BMTC) bus and preventing it from moving.

body.html:
A drunk man allegedly created a major disturbance in Indiranagar, Bengaluru, on February 17, 2026, by standing in front of a Bengaluru Metropolitan Transport Corporation (BMTC) bus and preventing it from moving.

According to witnesses, the man positioned himself directly in front of the bus on a busy road, causing traffic disruption. He reportedly made abusive hand gestures, including showing the middle finger, and attempted to provoke the driver through verbal abuse.

The incident raised concerns about passenger safety and road discipline, as the obstruction led to traffic congestion and posed risks to other motorists.

While similar incidents have been reported in other parts of Bengaluru in the past, this episode in Indiranagar has sparked fresh criticism over civic indiscipline and irresponsible behaviour under the influence of alcohol.

Police action in the matter is awaited.

articles.title: Lawyer Accused of Dragging Youth on Mercedes Bonnet After Road Collision in Ranchi
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A lawyer associated with the Jharkhand High Court has been accused of dragging a young man on the bonnet of his Mercedes car following a collision with a motorbike in Ranchi.

body.html:
A lawyer associated with the Jharkhand High Court has been accused of dragging a young man on the bonnet of his Mercedes car following a collision with a motorbike in Ranchi.

The incident reportedly occurred after a motorbike ridden by Nawaz Khan collided with a car allegedly driven by advocate Manoj Tandon. According to the victim’s mother, the accident led to an argument between the two.

She stated that Nawaz, who works with Tata Consultancy Services (TCS), had taken his brother to a Board examination centre on his motorbike and was returning when the collision took place. The impact allegedly damaged the bike.

“My son demanded compensation for the damage caused to his motorbike. During the argument, he held onto the car’s bonnet. Manoj Tandon then drove the car, dragging my son for several kilometres,” she alleged.

She further claimed that the lawyer took Nawaz to his flat, where he was allegedly assaulted by several people. “We want justice. I have registered a police case,” she said.

However, Ranchi Deputy Superintendent of Police PK Mishra stated that police are yet to receive a formal complaint in connection with the incident.

Further details are awaited.

articles.title: Woman Arrested for Allegedly Killing 4-Year-Old Niece, Stabbing Sister-in-Law in Muzaffarnagar
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: 📍 Muzaffarnagar | 17 February 2026 In a shocking incident in Basikalan village under Shahpur Police Station limits of Muzaffarnagar, police have arrested a woman for allegedly murdering her four-year-old niece and attempting to kill her sister-in-law.

body.html:
📍 Muzaffarnagar | 17 February 2026

In a shocking incident in Basikalan village under Shahpur Police Station limits of Muzaffarnagar, police have arrested a woman for allegedly murdering her four-year-old niece and attempting to kill her sister-in-law.

According to Senior Superintendent of Police Sanjay Kumar Verma, information was received around 2:30 am on February 17 that a minor girl had been kidnapped and a woman attacked with a knife. Police teams rushed to the spot through Dial 112.

On reaching the house, police found Firdous lying injured on a cot in her in-laws’ room with severe stab wounds to her abdomen. She was immediately shifted to the Community Health Centre and later referred to Meerut for advanced treatment. Doctors have stated that she is now out of danger.

During the search, the four-year-old girl was found dead inside a covered water tank within the house premises. Her body was floating on the surface. The body was sent for post-mortem after inquest proceedings.

An FIR (No. 44/2026) has been registered under Sections 109(1), 103(1), 118(1) of the BNS and Section 4/25 of the Arms Act.

During interrogation, Mana, daughter of Yamin and sister-in-law (nanad) of the victim, allegedly confessed to the crime. Police recovered the meat-cutting knife used in the attack at her instance.

According to police, the accused was in a relationship with a neighbour for the past two to three years. She alleged that her sister-in-law had fixed her marriage against her will and frequently stopped her from speaking to her lover. Police said she had been planning the crime for nearly a month and had procured sleeping pills eight days ago through an acquaintance.

On the night of the incident, she allegedly mixed 16 sleeping tablets into the family’s food and tea. While most members fell unconscious, the child was more severely affected. The accused then allegedly lifted the girl, climbed onto the tank using a brick, opened the lid and threw her inside, leading to her death. She later attacked her sister-in-law with a knife, striking her two to three times.

Police said the accused has shown no visible remorse during questioning and claimed she acted out of resentment and anger. The role of her alleged lover, whose location has been traced nearly 2,000 km away, is under investigation. One more person is suspected to have helped her procure the tablets.

The arrest was carried out by a team led by Station House Officer Gajendra Singh, along with SOG, cyber cell and other police officials. Further investigation is underway.

#Muzaffarnagar #UttarPradesh #CrimeNews #ShahpurPolice #LoveAffair #ForcedMarriage #ChildMurder #BreakingNews

articles.title: Youth Assaulted in Ujjain After Identity Revealed; Police Launch Probe
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A Muslim youth was allegedly assaulted by activists of Bajrang Dal in Ujjain, Madhya Pradesh, after his identity was revealed during questioning in the Nanakheda area on Monday night.

body.html:
A Muslim youth was allegedly assaulted by activists of Bajrang Dal in Ujjain, Madhya Pradesh, after his identity was revealed during questioning in the Nanakheda area on Monday night.

According to police, the youth, identified as Zafar Khan, had come to Ujjain from Mohali along with a 32-year-old woman. A video of the incident surfaced on Tuesday, showing the young man surrounded by several individuals and being questioned before he was allegedly beaten.

Allegations and Assault

As per local reports, Bajrang Dal activists had received information that young men and women from different states were staying at a hotel in the Nanakheda area. After waiting outside for nearly an hour, activists reportedly apprehended Zafar Khan, who was dressed in a dhoti-kurta, had applied tripundra on his forehead and was wearing a Rudraksha bead around his neck.

During questioning, he allegedly initially gave a Hindu name. However, upon further interrogation, he disclosed his real name as Zafar Khan. In the viral video, he identifies himself as a devotee of Lord Shiva and states that the woman had brought him to Ujjain for Visit at major temples.

He told those present that they had visited the Mahakaleshwar Temple, Harsiddhi Temple and Kaal Bhairav Temple.

After his identity was revealed, activists allegedly assaulted him. The video shows more than a dozen people surrounding him. During the incident, he reportedly sustained a head injury and began bleeding. Police reached the spot after receiving information.

Hotel Stay Controversy

District coordinator of Bajrang Dal, Rishabh Kushwaha, claimed that the couple had failed to secure rooms at multiple hotels before checking into one in Nanakheda. He alleged that the youth had given a Hindu name at the hotel and was dressed like a Pandit. He said the youth was later handed over to police.

Police Statement

Station House Officer Narendra Yadav of Nanakheda Police Station confirmed that both individuals are residents of Mohali and belong to different communities. He stated that the woman was aware of the youth’s religious identity and that they were known to each other.

Police said Aadhaar cards and other documents are being verified. Further action will be taken based on the complaint received. Investigation is underway.

articles.title: ‘Reel for Fame, Death on Road?’: New Video Fuels Outrage in Dwarka Crash That Killed 23-Year-Old
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A fresh development has intensified public outrage in the Dwarka road accident case in which 23-year-old Sahil Dhaneshra lost his life on February 3, 2026.

body.html:
A fresh development has intensified public outrage in the Dwarka road accident case in which 23-year-old Sahil Dhaneshra lost his life on February 3, 2026.

Sahil’s mother, Inna Makan, has renewed her demand for justice, alleging that the minor accused was speeding his Mahindra Scorpio to film a social media reel — a reckless act that allegedly cost her son his life.

Video Surfaces, Family Raises Questions

A video that has surfaced online purportedly shows a girl seated beside the teenage driver filming as he drives at high speed. In the footage, the SUV is seen swerving, narrowly missing a bus, before allegedly colliding head-on with Sahil’s motorcycle at around 11:57 am near Lal Bahadur Shastri College in Dwarka.

The family claims that the reel circulating on social media has been trimmed just before the exact moment of impact.

According to the allegations, the Scorpio was being driven in the wrong lane before it first struck Sahil’s motorcycle and then rammed into a parked taxi, seriously injuring its driver.

Minor Driver, No Licence

Police identified the driver as a 17-year-old minor, though some early reports had mentioned him as 19. Investigations confirmed that he did not possess a valid driving licence at the time of the accident.

The Scorpio involved in the crash was found to have 13 pending challans, including nine for overspeeding — most of them issued in Uttar Pradesh.

Legal Action and Bail Row

The Delhi Police registered an FIR under relevant sections of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) for rash driving and causing death by negligence. The minor’s father is also being prosecuted under Section 199A of the Motor Vehicles Act for allowing a minor to drive.

On February 10, the Juvenile Justice Board granted the minor interim bail to enable him to appear for his Class 10 board examinations. The decision has sparked significant public backlash.

Autopsy Findings

An autopsy report confirmed that Sahil died on the spot due to severe haemorrhage and cranio-cerebral injuries, including a fractured skull and multiple broken ribs.

The investigation into the circumstances leading to the crash is ongoing.
